Medtech Giant Accused of Hiding Patient Data

Medtech giant Medtronic is accused of hiding data from patients and doctors regarding the safety and effectiveness of its devices. Internal documents suggest the company was aware of potential risks associated with its spinal implants but did not fully disclose this information. This alleged suppression of data made it 'impossible for patients to give informed consent' for procedures. The company reportedly downplayed or omitted negative findings in its reports to regulators and the public. The revelations have raised concerns about patient safety and corporate transparency in the medical device industry.
